author: TeIq
content:
PR 1 landed. Wire-protocol foundation for the ML classifier epic is in place.

## Deliverables
- proto/polaris-classifier-v1.proto (4-RPC service: Classify, ClassifyStream, Feedback, HealthCheck)
- polaris-classifier-proto/ workspace crate (tonic-prost-build codegen, vendored protoc, leaf-shape deps)
- Workspace dep pins for tonic 0.14 ecosystem (tonic / tonic-prost / tonic-prost-build / tonic-build / prost / prost-types)

## Architect-run verification
- cargo build -p polaris-classifier-proto PASS
- cargo clippy -p polaris-classifier-proto -- -D warnings CLEAN
- cargo test -p polaris-classifier-proto PASS

## Implementation notes
- Direct authoring (no agent dispatch) — avoids the worktree-base-drift issue documented on #98
- protoc-bin-vendored makes the build hermetic across operator hardware
- The `build.rs` carries a narrow `#![allow(unsafe_code)]` for the pre-spawn `std::env::set_var("PROTOC", ...)` with justifying comment; the lib crate retains the workspace `unsafe_code = deny`
- The codegen output (in OUT_DIR) is not checked in — tonic-build's output is deterministic for a given .proto + tonic version, so diff-stability is by construction
